rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for disconnecting a device from an electrical socket.

example.english: Remember to unplug the appliance before leaving home.
example.traditional: 記得離開屋企前拔插頭。
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 lei4 hoi1 uk1 kei2 cin4 bat6 caap3 tau2

rows.note: Use this for taking a break from a phone or similar device, especially to relax or reduce stress.

example.english: I want to unplug from my phone tonight and go to bed earlier.
example.traditional: 我今晚想放低手機，早啲瞓覺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan1 soeng2 fong3 dai1 sau2 gei1 zou2 di1 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically when clearing a blocked drain or water pipe.

example.english: The sink is blocked, so I need someone to unplug the drain.
example.traditional: 個鋅盆塞咗，我要搵人通渠。
example.jyutping: go3 sing1 pun2 sak1 zo2 ngo5 jiu3 wan2 jan4 tung1 keoi4
